description: Per-call cost of the PyO3 boundary, by operation: config A (no Python) vs config B (real bridge) vs config P (Python calling the same mock directly).
metric: ns/call per HAL operation; B-A is the crossing
notes: Measured: the crossing is 82x at the call level on the 27-field DOM getter (1043 -> 7627 ns) and 97.6% of it is json.dumps + serde_json parse, not the GIL - a re-entrant with_gil is 2ns and the bare Python call 187ns. So it scales with PAYLOAD SIZE. But at daemon level it is only ~3% of a DOM sweep, because real DB I/O costs ~48us per HAL call. Both numbers are true and neither alone is honest; report them together.
